tagline: Four masts, 148 guests, and Raiatea every week from March 2027.
answer: Wind Star is Windstar's four-masted sailing yacht for 148 guests. From March 2027 she sails French Polynesia year round on the 7-night Dreams of Tahiti, with weekly Monday departures from Papeete, and every voyage visits Raiatea. Her six self-furling sails carry 21,500 sq ft of canvas; she was refreshed under Windstar's Setting Sails programme.
facts: 73 ocean view staterooms and 1 Owner's Suite
360 ft at the waterline, 440 ft with the bowsprit
4 masts of 204 ft; 6 self-furling sails, 21,500 sq ft
overview: Wind Star is a four-masted sailing yacht: four masts of 204 feet carry six triangular, self-furling, computer-operated sails, 21,500 square feet of Dacron. Windstar gives her speed as up to 15.8 knots with the wind, and 10 knots on engines alone.

She carries 148 guests with 105 crew. Windstar lists 73 deluxe ocean view staterooms and one Owner's Suite, and her restaurants as Amphora, the Veranda and Candles, all open seating and complimentary. She was redesigned under Windstar's Setting Sails programme.

From March 2027 she joins Star Breeze in French Polynesia, sailing the 7-night Dreams of Tahiti every week from Papeete, Monday departures, and every voyage calls at Raiatea, which Windstar's release describes as the ancestral homeland of the Māori people.
why: A real sailing yacht in Tahiti: four masts and six sails, for 148 guests.
Raiatea every week, the island that shares its lagoon with Taha'a, James's favourite in French Polynesia.
Seven nights from Papeete on a Monday, so a week of sailing fits neatly between nights on land.

faqs: When does Wind Star sail in Tahiti?
From March 2027, year round, per Windstar.
Wind Star's 7-night voyage from Papeete, with weekly Monday departures; every voyage visits Raiatea.
How many guests does Wind Star carry?
Is Wind Star a real sailing ship?
Yes. Four masts of 204 feet and six self-furling sails with 21,500 sq ft of canvas.
188 sq ft for the ocean view staterooms; the Owner's Suite is 220 sq ft.
Can I add Taha'a to a Wind Star week?
Yes. Taha'a shares Raiatea's lagoon, about 30 minutes across by boat, so Le Taha'a or Vahine Private Island sit naturally before or after a sailing.
Where should I stay before sailing?
A night on Tahiti first: InterContinental Tahiti or Le Tahiti by Pearl Resorts, both in the Ledger.
